summary: Custom internal web-based accounting & operations app for a ghost kitchen that migrates existing Excel-based expenses/COGS/sales tracking into a secure website while preserving Excel calculation logic 1:1, including form-based data entry, dashboards/KPIs, and print/PDF-ready financial reports.
architectural_notes: Preserve Excel spreadsheet calculation logic 1:1 in the web app (formulas/thresholds/layout parity).
Internal business management tool (not marketing site, POS, or generic accounting software).
Use a relational database with core tables: Expenses, Sales, COGS, Categories, Vendors, Payment Methods, and time periods; support derived/calculated fields.
Reports must be print-friendly and PDF/export-ready while matching existing spreadsheet layout logic.

existing_features.title: Implement secure user access for the internal accounting app using Internet Identity, with the ability to run as a single-business-user system now while remaining future-ready for roles/permissions.

Build form-based desktop-optimized UI for entering and editing Expenses, Sales/Revenue, and COGS with clean inputs and dropdowns, including validation and a table view for reviewing/editing existing entries.
Add master-data management screens to create/update/delete dropdown values for Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods, and ensure these dropdowns are used across all entry forms.

Implement automatic calculations for category totals, monthly totals, annual summaries, profit & loss statements, margins, and platform fees, and ensure the results match the existing Excel formulas 1:1 by supporting a clearly defined, testable set of formulas and expected outputs.

Create a main dashboard with KPIs and time-window performance views (current day, current month, last 3/6/12 months), including color-coded indicators (green profitable, red loss / margin below threshold).

Implement report views that match the spreadsheet-style layout logic and are print-friendly: daily summaries, monthly expense reports, monthly profit & loss statements, 3/6/12-month reports, and annual summaries, with PDF/export-ready printing via browser print styles.

Apply a consistent, clean, professional accounting UI theme optimized for desktop: neutral gray/slate base, clear typography, readable numeric tables, and consistent green/red semantics for positive/negative performance.

new_feature_requests.summary: Secure login for internal use (single business user now; future-ready for roles)
Form-based CRUD data entry for Expenses, Sales/Revenue, and COGS with clean UI and dropdowns
Editable dropdown master data management for Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods
Automatic calculations matching existing Excel formulas exactly (P&L, margins, category/monthly/annual totals, platform fees, thresholds)
Dashboard & KPI views for current day/month and last 3/6/12 months with color-coded indicators (green profit/red loss)
Printable and PDF/export-ready financial reports (daily, monthly expense, monthly P&L, 3/6/12-month, annual) matching spreadsheet layouts
Relational database schema for Expenses, Sales, COGS, Categories, Vendors, Payment Methods, and time periods supporting calculated fields
Desktop-optimized, neutral accounting UI theme with print-friendly layouts

Create persistent backend data models and CRUD APIs for Expenses, Sales/Revenue, COGS, Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods to replace the existing Excel storage while keeping data entry fields aligned with the spreadsheet columns.

projectName: Ghost kitchen internal accounting web app (Excel-matching logic): auth, CRUD, calculations, dashboards, and printable reports
